$comment: Corpus preset for a repo whose documentation is generated by the AIDD framework (github.com/ai-driven-dev/framework). Merged into review.config.json by `install.mjs --corpus aidd`. Everything it points at is GENERATED and read-only to this pipeline: AIDD writes it, the reviewers cite it, nothing here edits it.

corpus.$comment.rules: AIDD writes one rule per file with its scope in its own frontmatter - `paths` for Claude Code, `globs` for Cursor, `applyTo` for Copilot. The run reads those globs to work out which rules a diff engages. Keep the surfaces this repo actually installs; a directory that does not exist costs nothing but is noise.
corpus.$comment.memory: aidd_docs/memory/*.md is the durable project context - architecture, codebase map, testing, vcs. Descriptive, not normative: it is what a reviewer reads for background, never what it cites. Flat by AIDD's own convention.

coverageNotes.Corpus: generated by AIDD - rules are cited by path, never edited by this pipeline
